# {{ app_name }}

> A production FastAPI starter wired end to end: async SQLAlchemy 2.0,
> server-rendered HTMX, email and OAuth login on a revocable session store,
> Soniq background jobs, ruff and strict mypy on the deploy gate, and one
> Fabric command that ships to a real Linux host over SSH.

This file is generated for large language models that read sites to help users.
It points at the canonical, prose-bearing URLs - the marketing pages, the blog,
and the few JSON endpoints worth knowing about - and skips the auth flow,
HTMX partials, and asset routes that would only add noise to a summary.
